pages.text: One wire of any length and shape from a $(item)9:1 balun$(): it may bend at poles and connectors, but not branch or loop. It works on every band where the wire is at least half a wave long, but it is never resonant (SWR 2 or more) and only half as strong as a dipole.$(br2)Always use it with a $(l:radiocraft:antennas/tuners)tuner$(/l).
